literal: Deliberators eyes as because-of-conducting king, deliberators having-considered should-take.
translation: Since a king conducts his rule with his advisors as his very eyes, he must carefully evaluate and secure such men.
modern: அரசன் ஆராய்ந்து அறிவுரை கூறும் அறிஞர்களைத் தன் கண்களாகக் கொண்டு ஆட்சி செய்வதால், அத்தகைய அறிஞர்களை நன்கு ஆராய்ந்து தனக்குத் துணையாகச் சேர்த்துக்கொள்ள வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the vital role of wise counselors in a ruler's life. The word 'சூழ்வார்' (from the root 'சூழ்', meaning to deliberate or consider) refers to advisors who carefully analyze situations. Because a king relies on these advisors to act as his own eyes to guide his rule ('ஒழுகலான்'), he must first thoroughly evaluate ('சூழ்ந்து') and secure them. The repetition of the root 'சூழ்' elegantly highlights both the analytical nature of the advisors and the careful scrutiny the king must apply in choosing them.
